query: Rust Go CLI binary size startup

results.title: GitHub - ngs/cli-lang-bench: Startup and throughput benchmarks for small CLI tools written in Rust, Go, and Bun + TypeScript · GitHub
results.snippet: Release flags are the ones you would ship. Rust: opt-level = 3, LTO, codegen-units = 1, panic = "abort", stripped. Go: -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w". Bun: --compile --minify, plus a separate --bytecode target so the trade-off between binary size and startup is visible.

results.title: Rust vs Go for CLI Tools: A Practical Comparison | Besterry — Linux & DevOps Notes
results.snippet: Both are negligible for CLI tools. (The old argument about Go’s startup was mostly about JVM-vs-Go, not Go-vs-Rust.) Binary size Out of the box: Go: 5-15 MB for a small program Rust: 2-8 MB for a small program (with LTO and strip) After aggressive optimization:

results.title: RFC: Standardize Dex CLI in Go/Rust for lightweight binaries (<4MB) and native process orchestration · Issue #2 · patrickaigbogun/dex
results.snippet: Pros: Minimal binary size (~5–8 MB uncompressed, ~2 MB gzipped) with LTO/strip. Rich CLI ecosystem (clap). Cons: Slightly higher cross-compilation complexity in CI. ┌────────────────────────...

results.title: I Optimized a Rust Binary From 40MB to 400KB. Here’s How - DEV Community
results.snippet: What I got instead was a 40MB binary for a simple CLI tool that parsed JSON and made HTTP requests. My wake-up call came during a Docker deployment. The base image ballooned to 180MB, pushing our container startup time from 2 seconds to 8 seconds.

results.title: GitHub - johnthagen/min-sized-rust: 🦀 How to minimize Rust binary size 📦 https://github.com/johnthagen/min-sized-rust
results.snippet: By default, Rust includes file, line, and column information for panic!() and [track_caller] to provide more useful traceback information. This information requires space in the binary and thus increases the size of the compiled binaries.
